result.summary: The street environment is characterized by a wide roadway with embedded trolley tracks and a complete absence of marked pedestrian crossings. While sidewalks are provided on both sides, the lack of traffic calming and long crossing distances create a high-risk environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded metal tracks in the roadway can cause slips for pedestrians and catch bicycle wheels.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, forcing pedestrians to cross a wide street unprotected.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The excessive width of the roadway encourages higher speeds and increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Provide a protected space in the center of the road for pedestrians to wait while crossing.

result.summary: The intersection features sidewalks on both sides but lacks marked pedestrian crossings across the primary roadway. The wide asphalt expanse and absence of high-visibility infrastructure or traffic calming measures create a moderately hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There is no marked crosswalk across the main roadway, forcing pedestrians to cross without designated space or priority.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Overgrown vegetation on the right corner may block the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the green utility box

hazards.name: Wide Intersection Radius
hazards.description: The wide, open corners allow for higher vehicle turning speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks across all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at corners to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Clear vegetation and restrict parking near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane urban thoroughfare with embedded streetcar tracks and no visible pedestrian crossing infrastructure. The environment is hostile to pedestrians due to the long unprotected crossing distance and the lack of marked crosswalks or refuge islands.

hazards.name: Embedded Streetcar Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the roadway can be slippery when wet and create tripping hazards for pedestrians crossing mid-block.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway extending into the distance

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic and tracks without any physical protection or refuge.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross, increasing the risk of mid-block crossing conflicts.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at regular intervals to provide designated crossing points.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Construct raised islands in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at potential crossing points to reduce the total crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a mixed-use urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a simple marked crosswalk. However, there is a lack of visible traffic control devices like stop signs or signals at the immediate crossing, which increases risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Intersection
hazards.description: No stop sign or traffic signal is visible to control vehicles entering the intersection from the side street.

hazards.name: Low Visibility Crosswalk
hazards.description: The crosswalk is marked with only two thin parallel lines, which are less visible to drivers than high-visibility patterns.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the side street in the foreground

interventions.title: Install Stop Control
interventions.description: Add a stop sign to the side street approach to ensure vehicles yield to pedestrians and cross-traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing parallel line markings to a continental or ladder pattern to improve driver awareness.
